search_scope.note: Bounded snapshot of public API/search results and ESPnet recipe sources; no claim that every existing checkpoint has been located.

sample_rate_interpretation.conclusion: DNS and MS-SNSD recipes support 16k audio. sample_rate:8000 is a preprocessing argument and, with preprocessor:null, is not passed to build_model. It alone does not prove 8k training; 16k directory names alone do not prove 16k training either. Exact uploaded checkpoint audio manifests are not available in these model repositories.
